implementation.receipt_and_provenance_architecture: Added ResearchExecutionReceipt dataclass and resolve_run_provenance() in services/control-plane/bff/agora/research/receipt.py. Server resolves provenance from authentic receipts by run_id, verifying owner, correlation_id, and terminal status. Unknown receipt versions return unavailable. Initial run projections default to unavailable without trusting client parameters.
implementation.correlation_chain: Single continuous correlation chain (trace_id / correlation_id) wired across Workshop messages/events, ResearchExecutionReceipt, candidate pool members, Trading Room decisions, Outbox handoffs, and telemetry-triggered AdjustmentSuggestions.
implementation.performance_suggestion_consumer: Added consume_telemetry_outcome in services/control-plane/bff/agora/performance/consumer.py attaching PerformanceSuggestionProducer directly to canonical evaluation/telemetry outcome events without adding any new background scheduler.

mandatory_deletions.client_supplied_real_provenance_flags: Deleted routing.get('backend_mode', 'real') default in _build_run_projection; initial projection defaults to unavailable until authentic ResearchExecutionReceipt is recorded and validated.
mandatory_deletions.fake_synchronous_terminal_fallbacks: Removed fake synchronous completion assumptions; dispatch leaves runs in queued state for outbox worker consumption; verified fail-closed lease, retry, DLQ, and crash recovery mechanics.
mandatory_deletions.manual_only_suggestion_production: Replaced manual suggestion injection with consume_telemetry_outcome attached to evaluation/telemetry events.

implementation.rollback_plan: Disable new consumers and deploy the prior exact paper-safe release without deleting canonical receipts.
